test_graph_equality: test two graphs for equality using gtn.equal() to check if they have identical structure and weights
test_graph_isomorphism: test two graphs for isomorphism using gtn.isomorphic() to check if they have the same structure
load_graph_from_text: load a graph from a text file using gtn.loadtxt() to read graph data from disk
save_graph_to_text: save a graph to a text file using gtn.savetxt() to write graph data to disk
save_load_graph_binary: save and load a graph using gtn.save() and gtn.load() for binary serialization
